description:
Stream Route for TCP/UDP (L4) proxying. Matches transport-layer connections by client IP, server address/port, or SNI.

Declarative stream route configuration. The optional `modifiedIndex` controls resource-level change detection with the YAML configuration provider.

update_time.description: Unix timestamp of last update. Read-only.

remote_addr.description: Client IP address or CIDR range to match.

sni.description: SNI hostname to match. Supports wildcard hostnames. Mutually exclusive with `snis`.

modifiedIndex.description: Optional resource version used for change detection by the YAML configuration provider.

snis.description: Alternative SNI hostnames to match, including wildcard hostnames. Mutually exclusive with `sni`.

tls_passthrough.description: On a listener configured with both `tls` and `tls_passthrough`, `true` forwards encrypted TLS bytes to the upstream; `false` terminates TLS at APISIX. Ignored on dedicated listeners. Passthrough requires a TCP upstream, not scheme `tls`.
